in_sanskrit.name: तितान
in_sanskrit.meaning: Titan, the god of the sky and earth in Greek mythology
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Titan is a primordial deity in Greek mythology, one of the twelve Titans, the elder children of Uranus and Gaia. The Titans ruled the world before the Olympian gods took their place.

It means 'Divine lineage of Titan', evoking images of strength, courage, and leadership. Titan was the leader of the Titans, the elder race of gods in Greek mythology. In Hinduism, this name is associated with the divine and the powerful. It is a name for a leader, a hero, or someone who embodies strength and courage.
